landmarks.name: Challenger Deep (Hadal Axis)
landmarks.description: Deepest verified sounding on Earth. Tectonic subduction trough of the Pacific Plate under the Mariana Microplate.

landmarks.name: Sirena Deep Subduction Axis
landmarks.description: Ultra-deep hadal fault basin along the southwestern curve of the Mariana subduction arc.

landmarks.name: Mariana Microplate Forearc Ridge
landmarks.description: Submarine forearc volcanic ridge rising over 9,300 meters above the adjacent trench floor.

landmarks.name: TAG Hydrothermal Complex
landmarks.description: Active high-temperature polymetallic sulfide hydrothermal field venting black smoker fluids at 360°C.

landmarks.name: Central Axial Rift Valley
landmarks.description: Spreading graben between the North American and Eurasian/African lithospheric plates.

landmarks.name: West Flank Rift Crest Peak
landmarks.description: High volcanic crest peak flanking the western margin of the central rift chasm.

landmarks.name: Milwaukee Deep (Atlantic Chasm)
landmarks.description: Deepest location in the Atlantic Ocean. Subduction boundary between the Caribbean and North American plates.

landmarks.name: Brownson Deep Tectonic Escarpment
landmarks.description: Nearly vertical subduction fault wall of fractured oceanic lithosphere dropping toward the trench axis.

landmarks.name: Insular Shelf Slope Break
landmarks.description: Steep dropoff descending from the shallow Puerto Rico island platform into the deep chasm.

landmarks.name: Carlsberg Spreading Axial Rift
landmarks.description: Slow-spreading divergent mid-ocean ridge boundary separating the African and Indo-Australian plates.

landmarks.name: Carlsberg Ridge Peak Massif
landmarks.description: Tectonic volcanic summit rising steeply above the surrounding abyssal plains of the Arabian Basin.

bay-of-bengal.name: Bay of Bengal (Swatch of No Ground Canyon)

landmarks.name: Swatch of No Ground Deep Axis
landmarks.description: Steep submarine canyon deeply incising the Bengal continental shelf margin and funneling sediments to the Bengal Fan.

landmarks.name: Ganges Delta Continental Shelf
landmarks.description: Shallow epicontinental sediment platform directly influenced by the discharge of the Ganges-Brahmaputra river system.

landmarks.name: Sigsbee Deep Abyssal Plain
landmarks.description: Deepest basin in the Gulf of Mexico, underlain by massive Jurassic salt canopies.

landmarks.name: Hellenic Trench Arc (Calypso Deep)
landmarks.description: Deepest tectonic subduction trough in the Mediterranean Sea south of the Peloponnese.

landmarks.name: Sargasso Central Abyssal Floor
landmarks.description: Stable, oligotrophic abyssal floor draped in pelagic calcareous foraminiferal sediment.

landmarks.name: Queensland Continental Slope Break
landmarks.description: Abrupt bathymetric escarpment dropping from shallow coral bioherms into the Queensland Basin.

landmarks.name: Philippine Trench (Emden Deep)
landmarks.description: Narrow, ultra-deep hadal subduction chasm formed by the Philippine Sea Plate colliding with the Eurasian Plate.
